text:
```artifact
@start
mode OfflineConsultation
  state PaymentMethod
    event PayWithVideo
      guard isVideoPaymentEnabled
      transition PaymentMethod.PaymentConfirmation
    event PayWithCreditDebitNetBanking
      guard isCreditDebitNetBankingEnabled
      transition PaymentMethod.PaymentConfirmation
  state PaymentConfirmation
    event ConfirmPayment
      transition PaymentConfirmation.PaymentSuccess
    event CancelPayment
      transition PaymentMethod.PaymentMethodSelection
  state PaymentSuccess
    event Close
      transition OfflineConsultation.Completed
  state PaymentMethodSelection
    event SelectVideoPayment
      transition PaymentMethod.PaymentMethodSelection
    event SelectCreditDebitNetBanking
      transition PaymentMethod.PaymentMethodSelection
  state Completed
    event Close
      transition OfflineConsultation.Closed
@end
```
